cases.description: The record part of a reference is always singular, so a reference declared cardinality: many whose record does not exist is ref-dangling, while one into a record that exists and matches nothing is ok with no targets (§8.2, §8.5, decision I1.8).
A reference into a record with a structural error cannot be resolved; it is not dangling but a ref-target-unreadable warning, at the $body that holds the link (§8.5, decision I1.9).
An x-vmd-ref without targets allows any node in the store (§9.3, decision I1.11).
With targets, a reference outside them is ref-target-not-allowed, for contrast (§9.3).
